summary.description: High-level summary of the documentation drift audit.

scanned_files.description: Total number of documentation files inspected.

drift_count.description: Total count of confirmed drift items.

rule_id.description: Identifier for drift rule (e.g. doc-broken-link, doc-missing-file, doc-deleted-reference, doc-missing-symbol, doc-unknown-cli-flag, doc-spec-drift).

path.description: Relative path of the markdown document containing the drift.

line_number.description: Line number where the drift was identified.

snippet.description: Excerpt or line showing the outdated or broken reference.

title.description: Brief human-readable summary of the drift.

description.description: Detailed explanation of what drifted between spec and codebase.

remediation.description: Actionable instructions to resolve the drift.
